summary: The Nebius AI Builder Program is a free membership layer for AI builders. After completing the registration form and verifying your email (double opt-in), members receive promotional credit codes for USD $25 in Nebius Token Factory credits and USD $25 in Tavily partner credits; both expire 90 days from issuance. Programme credits cannot be used for production workloads, large-scale commercial deployment, or revenue-generating activity beyond prototyping and experimentation. Nebius marketing cites $400+ in total credits and discounts across partners (LangChain, Toloka, and more), plus member-rate $1 certifications, office hours, and community benefits. One account per verified email; disposable email domains are blocked and corporate/educational addresses preferred. Distinct from the existing $1 Nebius Token Factory trial credit.
claim_steps: Complete the Builder Program registration form (name, email, company or university, role, country, what you are building) and accept the program terms.
Verify your email via the double opt-in message — membership activates only after verification.
Redeem the issued promo codes: $25 for Nebius Token Factory and $25 for Tavily. Credits expire 90 days from issuance.
Use Programme credits for prototyping and experimentation, not production workloads, large-scale commercial deployment, or revenue-generating activity beyond that scope.
